notes: Reverse-engineer a specified binary container (magic/version/flags header, variable header length with junk padding, optional 2-byte repeating XOR mask over the payload, either float32 endianness, row- vs column-major storage, 4-byte CRC trailer that must not be read as data) and ship a runnable extractor that numpy.saves the recovered matrix. Hard floor: the deliverable must be a general executable (/app/extract.py) plus the persisted /app/recovered.npy, verified by executing it on hidden containers that flip every flag combination (big/little endian, C/Fortran order, masked/unmasked, padded/unpadded headers) and checking exact values, shape, dtype, and orientation. Nonzero rubric for reasoning_depth (multi-field header + mask + order/endianness interplay), adversarial_inputs (trailer trap, junk padding), hidden_case_generalization (flag-flipped hidden containers), quantitative_correctness (exact float matrix equality), and small tool/dependency credit for the two-stage write-then-run flow.
